theme.notes: Coconut crab titan of the islands: a colossal orange-red coconut crab with purple-dark joints, so big you mostly see its spiky legs stepping over you; it climbs palms, drops and cracks coconuts and wears husk on its armour.

creatures.name: Robber Crab Baron
creatures.art: blue-grey, wears a stolen sash and ring

theme.notes: Robber crab baron of coast and island: a blue-grey robber crab who calls himself a baron, wearing a stolen red sash and a gold ring; pompous and staggering, his armour and shell are patched with loot.

Great hawk of the grassland: a big red-tailed hawk, warm brown with a pale chest and a rufous fan tail; it circles high over the meadow, its shadow sweeping the grass, then folds and stoops onto prey and mantles over it with spread wings.

Ancient snapping turtle of the wetland: an alligator snapper centuries old, olive and rough, barnacles and moss on its head and keeled shell; it lies patient on the bottom with its pink worm lure, then the hooked beak slams shut.

Reef leviathan of the coast: a vast mottled green sea serpent with a yellow fin crest and yellow eyes; its humps breach out of the reef water, it lurks in coral, whips up whirlpools and swallows prey whole.

Old Bramblehorn of the forest: an ancient thicket stag grown out of the wood itself, mossy and bark-dark, whose great antlers are bramble canes with hooked red thorns, pale bone tips and blackberries; roots for hooves, sap for blood, and the thicket hides its eyes.

Dune Wyrm of the desert: a colossal sand-gold wyrm of armoured rings with a round mouth full of inward teeth; it swims under the dunes, erupts out of a sand mound, opens sinkholes to swallow prey whole, shakes the ground, spouts sand and spits acid.

Snow owl monarch of the tundra and mountains: a huge pure-white snowy owl with black flecks, yellow eyes and furry 'slipper' feet; it glides without a sound, listens for lemmings under the snow, leaves wing prints where it lifts off, and rules the white silence (all its class pieces are 'Hush').

creatures.name: Frost Owl Regent
creatures.art: smaller, ice-blue edge, thin silver crown

theme.notes: Frost owl regent of the tundra: a smaller pale owl whose feathers are rimmed in ice blue, wearing a thin silver crown; it rules with frost: rime creeps where it passes, frost ferns spell its edicts, its glare freezes and its wings vanish into whiteout.

Storm eagle of the mountain peaks: a huge storm-grey eagle with white-edged fingered wings and a yellow hooked beak; it rides the gale, nests on a crag eyrie, and dives with the storm so that lightning seems to come down with it.

Jade Jaguar Spirit of the rainforest: the ghost of a great jaguar carved in living jade, translucent green with gold rosettes and glowing eyes, the guardian of an old carved mask; it flickers between stone and spirit, stalks unseen, drops out of the canopy and holds prey with its gaze.

th.note: Husk Armour: husk-padded armour plates line the edge, loose fibres drifting off

entries.name: Dune Heave
entries.note: override: heave = heavy body slam; avoids slash pile; palette land:desert

th.note: Dune Heave: the whole ringed body heaves up out of a sand mound and crashes back down, sand clods flying

entries.name: Quake
entries.note: override: quake = ground shaking thump (trip); palette land:desert

th.note: Quake: the ground splits in jagged cracks at spots along the edge, tied by taut lines, sand chunks jumping out: the foe stumbles

entries.name: Dune Burrow
entries.note: override: burrowing sand wave, no tag/keyword; best guess; palette land:desert

th.note: Dune Burrow: the wyrm sinks and its ringed head surfaces at one spot after another along the edge, sand dust puffing, never where you look

entries.name: Sand Swallow
entries.note: override: swallow = gulp; maw-like bite; palette land:desert

th.note: Sand Swallow: sinkholes open out of the edge, sand rings sliding into a dark centre, and the round red maw snaps up out of the bottom

entries.name: Sand Spout
entries.note: override: spout of sand is a dust jet, not electric shock; palette land:desert

th.note: Sand Spout: quick jets of sand shoot off the edge one after another, crown into spray and rain back down
Burrow Under: the wyrm dives and sand-wave arcs swell out from the edge as it swims beneath, a gold glint, then the sand settles back
Hush Veil: soft white fringed feathers line the edge and sway without a sound, a veil the blow sinks into
Hush Beak: round feathered owl faces lunge off the edge and the small black beak nips, with not a sound

entries.name: Hush Stoop
entries.note: override: silent stoop = point-first dive; differs from Hush Beak bite and Talons slash; palette land:tundra

th.note: Hush Stoop: the white owl drops off the edge on silent wings, feet out at the end, snow falling around it
Hush Lift: the owl lifts off the snow and is gone, leaving only fanned wing prints pressed into the drift and a snow puff
Hush Talons: furry white feet slam out of the edge, the black talons curl and grip

entries.name: Frost Wing
entries.note: override: frost wing that trips = ice glints; best guess vs slash; palette land:tundra

th.note: Frost Wing: a long white barred wing sweeps through and its frost crystals hang at spots, tied in a frozen web that trips the foe

entries.name: Hush Plan
entries.note: override: no tag/keyword; a plan spreading out quietly, best guess; palette land:tundra

th.note: Hush Plan: at one snow mound after another the owl cocks its head and listens to a lemming tunnelling below, then plunges
Royal Talon: a furry white slipper foot runs the length of the edge, black talons out, raking frost scratches as it goes

entries.name: Snow Glare
entries.note: override: glare = icy glint (glare/glint like lure/sheen); palette land:tundra

th.note: Snow Glare: round white owl faces with blazing yellow eyes spread out in the snow, stare, blink and draw back

entries.name: Silent Glide
entries.note: override: silent glide of soft feathers; keeps shield for Hush Veil; palette land:tundra

th.note: Silent Glide: the great white owl lines the edge with its spread wings, gliding in place without a sound, a wall of white feathers
Frost Shroud: frost ferns grow up along the edge like window frost and stay, a shroud of ice fronds
Frost Beak: ice-rimmed owl faces lunge out and the little black beak nips
Frost Swoop: the smaller ice-edged owl swoops low along the length of the edge on silent wings
Frost Vanish: the owl blinks out into a snow flurry here and there along the edge, never twice in the same place

entries.name: Frost Crown
entries.note: override: thin silver crown strike glints; art line crown; palette art-word

th.note: Frost Crown: the crowned head butts out of the edge and the circlet points flash white

entries.name: Rime Talon
entries.note: override: rime talon stab; frost is not electric, quick tag stays mechanical; palette art-word

th.note: Rime Talon: frost-crusted talons rake off the edge in a quick flurry, a white rime line growing where they scratch

entries.name: Frost Edict
entries.note: override: a royal decree as a ward; no tag/keyword, best guess; palette art-word

th.note: Frost Edict: frost ferns are spelled out at spots along the edge, tied by thin ice lines like a written decree
Whiteout Wing: the pale wing spreads out and blurs into driving snow until only the snow is left, then draws back

entries.name: Ice Glare
entries.note: override: ice glare = glint; palette art-word

th.note: Ice Glare: pale eyes with ice-blue irises push out along the edge, the glare streaming out and freezing into icicle tips

entries.name: Throne Feint
entries.note: override: feint = a ripple of unease; not electric; palette art-word

th.note: Throne Feint: the small crowned head blinks from spot to spot along the edge, a glint running over the silver circlet each time
Storm Pinion: broad grey pinions line the edge and beat against the gale, rain streaming off them

entries.name: Storm Hook
entries.note: override: storm hook = hooked beak; palette land:mountain

th.note: Storm Hook: the hooked eagle beak lunges off the edge, gapes and tears
Storm Plunge: eagles fold and plunge straight down off the edge like falling stones

entries.name: Storm Updraft
entries.note: override: updraft = rising air waves; keeps puff for Gale Wing; palette land:mountain

th.note: Storm Updraft: storm clouds billow up off the edge on the updraft, lightning flickering inside, rain trailing
Storm Clutch: an eagle foot slams out gripping a lightning bolt that forks and flashes

entries.name: Thunder Dive
entries.note: override: thunder dive lands point-first; keeps shock for Lightning Claw; palette land:mountain

th.note: Thunder Dive: the grey eagle folds and dives out of the edge with a crackle, slams down talons first, sparks at the wingtips

entries.name: Storm Gust
entries.note: override: gust of wind; no tag/keyword, best guess; palette land:mountain

th.note: Storm Gust: one great wing gives a downstroke and a burst of white gust lines shoves out from the edge
Lightning Claw: yellow feet clutching forked lightning bolts flash off the edge one after another, white afterglow
Gale Wing: great grey wings beat out from the edge, white gale curls and slanting rain push the blow away, then fold back
Eyrie Grip: stick nests on grey crags line the edge, the eagle sitting tall and gripping the rim while the wind tears twigs away
Jade Poise: carved jade jaguar masks line the edge, calm and still, the gold rosette on the brow, a glint walking over the stone
Jade Rake: four parallel claw gouges tear out of the edge diagonally, gold at the tips, flaring pale jade

entries.name: Jade Pounce
entries.note: override: quick pounce flash; best guess vs slash; palette land:rainforest

th.note: Jade Pounce: the spirit cat bursts out of the edge in one leap and lands back hard, a glint running over the jade
Jade Slink: the jaguar slinks low along the edge, half stone and half spirit outline, then bumps in

entries.name: Jade Throttle
entries.note: override: throttle = jaws clamp on the throat; palette land:rainforest

th.note: Jade Throttle: jade jaws gape off the edge, the two white fangs clamp shut and crunch
Jaguar Pounce: the jade spirit jaguar runs the length of the edge in bounding leaps, crouch, stretch, tuck, and lands with gold paw sparks

entries.name: Jade Stalk
entries.note: override: silent stalk, no tag/keyword; soft dust best guess; palette land:rainforest

th.note: Jade Stalk: glowing jade paw prints appear one at a time at spots along the edge and fade, the stalker itself never seen

entries.name: Jade Canopy Drop
entries.note: override: canopy drop: leaves fall with the jaguar; pierce tag overridden by art; palette land:rainforest

th.note: Jade Canopy Drop: the jade jaguar drops head-first out of the canopy, forepaws spread and claws out, leaves fluttering round it

entries.name: Jade Gaze
entries.note: override: jade gaze glints; trip tag is the hold, art beats web; palette land:rainforest

th.note: Jade Gaze: floating pairs of gold-and-jade jaguar eyes hang at spots, glow rings pulsing, tied together by thin gold lines: the foe is held in a trance
Spirit Stalk: the jaguar drifts out from the edge flickering between solid jade and a pale dotted spirit outline, and the blow passes through it
